summary: Kroger filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an offering of two new senior note series: notes due 2032 and notes due 2036, with coupons, principal amounts and pricing left blank in this preliminary version. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital markets takedown off an existing April 21, 2026 shelf registration (File 333-295223), not a special situation. Joint book-running managers are Citigroup, Mizuho and Wells Fargo Securities. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; no price per share, premium or equity event; total debt was about $17.0 billion at August 15, 2026.
